mapper.update: UPDATE MB_TOPIC SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, MAX_LEN = #{maxLen}, AI = #{ai}, PROMPT = #{prompt}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TOPIC_NO = #{topicNo}
mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO AS userNo, U.ID AS id, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS profileUrl, TO_CHAR(F.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS followDate FROM MB_TOPIC_FOLLOW F INNER JOIN MB_USER U ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE F.TOPIC_NO = #{topicNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, U.USER_NO DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MB_TOPIC WHERE 1=1 AND ENABLED = FALSE AND UPDATE_DATE < DATEADD('DAY', -${day}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
